topic: Mihawk left Marineford when Shanks arrived out of respect for a dead rivalry, not fear
title: Why Mihawk Walked Away From Shanks At Marineford
description: Mihawk left Marineford the moment Shanks showed up, and fans keep calling it fear. Here's why I think it was about the one rivalry he actually cared about. What do you think?
comment: Was Mihawk scared of Shanks or just done with him? Pick one.

lines.text: Why did Mihawk walk away the second Shanks arrived?

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman on a battlefield

lines.text: Everyone says he was scared. I don't buy it.
Mihawk and Shanks used to be real rivals, the kind who fought for fun.

shot.fallback: two swordsmen sparring on a ship

lines.text: Then Shanks lost his left arm.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate with an empty sleeve

lines.text: And Mihawk lost interest in him. Just like that.
Fast forward to Marineford. Mihawk is swinging at Luffy, and he even mutters an apology to Shanks.

shot.fallback: swordsman slashing at a boy with a straw hat

lines.text: Then Shanks walks in, and Mihawk leaves.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate stopping a war

lines.text: He said fighting Shanks was beyond what the World Government paid him for.

shot.fallback: swordsman sheathing a giant black blade

lines.text: That's not fear. That's a man refusing to cheapen a fight.
A duel he cared about died with that arm, and he won't fake it for a war.

shot.fallback: two silhouettes facing each other at sunset

lines.text: Now think about who he trained on Kuraigana for two years.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman training in a castle

lines.text: Maybe Mihawk is still waiting for one more real fight.

shot.fallback: swordsman raising a black blade toward a challenger

lines.text: And that's the only reason Mihawk would ever walk away.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman leaving a battle
